description.summary: Target creature’s Intelligence and Charisma scores each drop to 1.
description.value: Target creature’s Intelligence and Charisma scores each drop to 1. The affected creature is unable to use Intelligence– or Charisma-based skills, cast spells, perform songs, understand language, or communicate coherently. Still, it knows who its friends are and can follow them and even protect them. The subject remains in this state until this effect is cured with Restoraga or Basuna . A creature that can cast spells, such as a black mage or a white mage, takes a -4 penalty on its saving throw.
